summary.en: magpie-Floatboat: drives the New API gateway behind the Floatboat desktop client — same browser sign-in as the app, exchanges the session for the gateway sk- key, then relays chat through it. 13 models, credit balance and the two-day signup bonus.
summary.zh: magpie-Floatboat：把 Floatboat 桌面端背后的 New API 网关接进 magpie —— 与客户端同一套浏览器登录，用会话换网关的 sk- key，再把对话原样转发过去。13 个模型、积分余额、首日/次日新手积分。
